meta.title: Ondra Breathing
meta.description: When to show that she is typing, and when to take it back. It stays hidden during the long pauses when her mind wanders — an indicator lit for nine seconds with nothing arriving is more dishonest than none at all. Breathing gestures are capped at two a day, and any single gesture at one, because stretching twice in a day is itself suspicious. It only answers whether and which one; it neither sends nor draws.
